title: The media
descriptionFa: انواع برنامه‌ی تلویزیونی، روزنامه و تبلیغ، و آدم‌هایی که خبر تهیه می‌کنن.

words.example: The media talked about the earthquake for weeks.
words.tipFa: یعنی تلویزیون، رادیو، روزنامه و اینترنت با هم.

words.example: I watch the news every evening.
words.tipFa: با s تموم می‌شه ولی مفرده: The news is on now، نه are.

words.example: What channel is the football match on?
words.tipFa: کانال عوض کردن: change the channel.

words.example: My grandmother never misses her favourite soap opera.
We watched a documentary about the Persian Gulf.
This nature programme is about the Persian leopard.
She talked about her new film on a talk show.
Reality TV shows ordinary people, not actors.
My dad watches every sports programme on Friday nights.
I saw an advert for a new phone on the bus.
I watched an interview with a famous footballer.
words.tipFa: an interview with someone. مصاحبه‌ی کاری هم interview هست.

words.example: A reporter asked the minister a difficult question.
My aunt is a journalist for a newspaper in Tehran.
I read an interesting article about space.
